content: Eko Gelo Timirte
Yesuusi hessafe dendidi, Yihuda biitta bidi Yordaanose Shaafa pinnis. Daro asay zaaridi iyako shiiqin, kaseysadaka he asaa tamaarsis.
Issi issi Farsaaweti paacanaw koyidi Yesuusa, “Issi asi ba machiw yeddana mela Muse higgey kiittii?” yaagidi iya oychidosona.
I zaaridi, “Musey hintena woygidi kiittidee?” yaagis.
Enti, “Musey, ‘Issi asi ba machees anjo worqate immidi yeddo’ gis” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi zaaridi, enta “Hinte odin si7onnayisata gidiya gisho, Musey ha kiitaa hintew xaafis.
Shin Xoossay koyro medhiya wode, addenne macca oothidi, enta medhis.
Hessa gisho, issi asi ba aawanne ba aayiw aggidi, ba machera issife de7ees.
Enti nam7ay issi ase gidoosona; hizape, enti issi ase gidoosonape attishin, nam7u asi gidokona.
Hessa gisho, Xoossay issife qachidaysa asi shaakofo” yaagis.
Enti soo simmida wode, iya tamaareti ha odabaa Yesuusa nam7antho oychidosona.
Yesuusi entako, “Ba machiw yeddidi hara ekiya oonika laymatees.
Qassi maccasiyaka ba azinaape keyada hara azina geliko laymatawusu” yaagis.
Yesuusi Yooga Nayta Anjis
Yesuusi guutha nayta bolla ba kushiya wothana mela, issi issi asay nayta iyako ehoosona, shin iya tamaareti he asa hanqetidosona.
Yesuusi hessa be7idi, ba tamaareta hanqetidi; entako, “Guutha nayti taako yeysa diggofite; Xoossaa kawotethay haysata melasa.
Taani hintew tuma odayis; Xoossaa kawotethaa guutha na7ada ekonna uray oonika he kawotethaa ubbaraka gelenna” yaagis.
Guutha nayta idimmidi, ba kushiya enta issuwa issuwa bolla wothidi anjis.
Dure Na7atetha Ura
Yesuusi baanaw keyda wode, issi uray woxi yidi, iya sinthan gulbatidi, “Keeha astamaariyaw, taani merinaa de7o laattanaw ay ootho?” yaagidi oychis.
Yesuusi, “Ayis tana keehaw gada xeegay? Xoossaa xalaalape attishin, hari keehi oonika baawa.
Xoossaa kiitaa, wodhopa; laymatopa; kaysotopa; wordo markatofa; inxarsan cimmofa; ne aawanne ne aayiw boncha yaageysa eraasa” yaagis.
Uray, “Astamaariyaw, taani hessa ubbaa na7atethafe doomada ha77i gakanaw naagayis” yaagis.
Yesuusi uraa tishshi oothi xeellidi dosis; “New issibay pacees; bada new de7iyaba ubbaa bayzada, he miishiya manqotas imma; neeni salon dure gidana. Yaata simmada tana kaalla” yaagis.
Shin uray hessa si7idi, I daro dure gidiya gisho, ba som7uwa kareethis, ufaytonna aggidi bis.
Yesuusi ba tamaareta yuushshi aathi xeellidi, “Dure asi Xoossaa kawotethaa gelanaysi waanidi metandeesha!” yaagis.
Iya tamaareti iya timirtiya si7idi malaaletidosona. Shin Yesuusi qassika entako, “Nayto, Xoossaa kawotethaa gelanaysi waanidi metandeesha!
Dure asi Xoossaa kawotethaa gelanaysafe, gimaley narpe luhora aadheysi kawuyees” yaagis.
Iya tamaareti malaaletidi, “Yaatin, ooni attanee?” yaagidi, issoy issuwa oychidosona.
Yesuusi enta tishshi oothi xeellidi, “Haysi Xoossas danda7etesipe attishin, asas danda7etenna; Xoossas ubbabay danda7etees” yaagis.
Phexroosi Yesuusako, “Heko; nuuni nubaa ubbaa aggidi, nena kaallida” yaagis.
Yesuusi “Taani hintew tuma odayis; ta gishonne wongela gisho, keethe woyko ishata woyko micheta woyko aawa woyko aayo woyko machiw woyko nayta woyko gade aggida oonika,
ha77i ha wodiyan xeetu kushe keetha, ishata, micheta, aayeta, nayta, gadiya, goodetethara issife ekana. Sinthafe yaana wodiyanka merinaa de7uwa ekana.
Shin daroti ha77i dethan sinthe gididaysati guye gidana, qassi daroti ha77i guye gididaysati sinthe gidana” yaagis.
Yesuusi Ba Hayquwaba Heedzantho Odis

Yesuusaranne iya tamaaretara Yerusalaame bishin, Yesuusi ba tamaareta sinthan hemetees. Enti malaaletidosona. Iya kaalleysatika yayyidosona. Nam7antho, tammanne nam7u tamaareta gaxa kessidi, bana gakanaba dumma entaw haysada yaagidi odis.
“Heko, nuuni Yerusalaame ha77i keyoos. Yan Asa Na7ay, kahine halaqatasinne higge astamaaretas aadhidi imetana. Enti iya bolla hayqo pirdaa pirdana; qassi Ayhude gidonna deriyas iya aathidi immana.
Ayhude gidonna derey iya toochana, iya bolla cuttana, lisson garaafananne wodhana. I heedzu gallasape guye, hayqope dendana” yaagis.
Yayqoobanne Yohaanisa Woosa
Zabdiyoosa nayti Yayqoobinne Yohaanisi Yesuusako yidi, “Astamaariyaw, nuuni nena woossiyaba ubbaa nuus oothana mela koyoos” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi entako, “Taani hintew ay ootho?” yaagis.
Enti, “Neeni ne boncho kawotethan uttiya wode, nuupe issuwa ushacha baggara qassi issuwa haddirsa baggara utisarki” yaagidosona.
Shin Yesuusi entako, “Hinte ay woossiyako ereketa, ta uyanaw de7iya xuu7aa uyanaw danda7eetii? Qassi taani xammaqetanaw de7iya xinqatiya xammaqetanaw danda7eetii?” yaagis.
Enti zaaridi, “Ee danda7oos” yaagidosona. Yesuusi qassi, “Tumaka ta uyanaw de7iya xuu7aa hinte uyana, taani xammaqetanaw de7iya xinqatiya hinte xammaqetana.
Shin taape ushacha baggaranne haddirsa baggara uttanayisata dooranaw taw maati baawa, shin he bessay Xoossay immanaw giigisidi wothidaysatasa” yaagis.
Hanko tammu tamaareti hessa si7ida wode, Yayqoobanne Yohaanisa bolla hanqetidosona.
Yesuusi enta ubbaa baako xeegidi, “Ayhude gidonna asaa halaqati deriya haareyisata geetetidi xeegeteysanne haareysatas deriya bolla maati de7eysa hinte ereeta.
Shin hinte giddon hessa mela gidenna; hinte giddon gitatanaw koyey oonika hintew aylle gidanaw bessees.
Qassi hinte giddon ubbaafe bolla gidanaw koyey oonika hinte ubbaas aylle gidanaw bessees.
Hari attoshin, Asa Na7ayka, asaas oothanawunne darota wozanaw ba shempuwa aathidi immanaw ysipe attishin, asi iyaw oothana mela yibeenna” yaagis.
Qooqiya Barximoosa
Enti Iyaarko katama bidosona. Yesuusi ba tamaaretaranne daro asaara Iyaarkofe keyishin, Ximoosa na7ay, qooqey, Barximoosa geeteteysi, oge gaxan woossishe uttis.
Barximoosi, yaara aadhey Naazirete Yesuusa gididaysa si7ida wode, ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Dawita na7aa Yesuusa, tana maararki!” yaagis.
Daro asay iya, “Hayza!” gidi hanqetidosona. Shin, I ba qaala kaseysafe daro dhoqu oothidi, “Dawita na7aw, tana maararki!” yaagis.
Yesuusi eqidi, “Iya haa xeegite” yaagis. Enti qooqiyako, “Aykoy baawa, denda eqa, nena xeegees” yaagidosona.
Qooqey ba ma7uwa holi yeggidi, gupi dendi eqidi, Yesuusako bis.
Yesuusi, “Taani new ay oothana mela koyay?” yaagis. Qooqey, “Astamaariyaw, ta xeellanaw koyayis” yaagis.
Yesuusi, “Ba, ne ammanoy nena pathis” yaagis. Iiraka iya ayfey xeellin, Yesuusa kaallis.
